baseline.protection_evidence: Public main, local main, and origin/main were identical and clean; both public Actions workflows passed.
baseline.selection_reason: Current public release before bundling the complete dependency closure.

resources: GitHub EmergentKnowledgeGroup/PLOTKEEPER main, repository variables, repository secrets, and Actions
Local isolated Codex installation roots under Z:/Plotkeeper/runtime/qa
Installed Plotkeeper Codex integration for post-review verification
semantic_changes: Bundle and install the complete EKG-owned SpecSwarm, production-goal-contract, production-goal-review, adaptive-execution, and Plotkeeper guard components.
Bundle the complete upstream MSW, MSW Hook, and Timebox packages under their original CC BY 4.0 attribution.
Preserve unrelated local configuration and adaptive timing history while installing entirely from repository-local skill code.
Point the existing release verifier at this exact append-only contract so publication verifies the correction rather than the previous release.
Do not change Plotkeeper runtime behavior, dashboard behavior, package metadata, public license, or weaken release verification.
Do not remove existing hooks, guard enforcement, tests, or third-party attribution.
Do not include caches, bytecode, secrets, personal datasets, machine-specific receipts, or calibration history.

invariants: A clean isolated installation succeeds using only files in this repository and the installed Codex, Python, Git, and model platform.
Every skill-code dependency is distributed completely; platform capabilities are explicitly identified rather than misrepresented as vendored code.
MSW, Timebox, and MSW Hook retain Slopware Engineer attribution and CC BY 4.0 terms.
Adaptive history and unrelated hooks remain preserved.
The exact candidate is independently reviewed and the public release verifier and test workflows pass.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: The repository installer supplies SpecSwarm and its complete transitive skill-code dependency closure without downloading skill code.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: A required skill may not be merely mentioned, assumed, or fetched from another marketplace.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: A new Plotkeeper user installing from a clean isolated Codex home.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Ownership and licensing identify SpecSwarm and EKG governance as EKG-owned and preserve Slopware attribution for upstream packages.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Plotkeeper may not claim Slopware material or describe vendored dependencies as separately fetched.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: The public release verifier validates this exact contract, candidate, evidence, and deployment receipt.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Publication may not reuse the preceding release contract or receipt.

proof_requirements.claim: The transitive skill dependency inventory is complete.
proof_requirements.required_environment: Repository, canonical skill sources, and bundled manifest
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Compare every referenced skill, script, hook, reference, and package file to the manifest and installed output.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: No required skill artifact is absent or marketplace-only.

proof_requirements.claim: A clean offline-style isolated install contains and validates every bundled dependency.
proof_requirements.required_environment: Fresh Z-drive Codex home with plugin network operations disabled
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Install locally, compare hashes, invoke the portable bridge, validate hooks, and run all tests.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: All bundled skills and hooks are present and functional without a skill download.

proof_requirements.claim: Notices and docs accurately identify EKG and Slopware ownership and license boundaries.
proof_requirements.required_environment: Tracked repository documentation and vendored licenses
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Review NOTICE, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES, README, integration docs, dependency manifest, and copied package license.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: Every bundled component has an accurate owner and license statement.

proof_requirements.claim: The fail-closed public release path is bound to the exact correction.
proof_requirements.required_environment: Exact clean candidate, signed phase receipts, GitHub configuration, and public Actions
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Run independent production review, exact verifier positive and adversarial checks, guarded push, and public reconciliation.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: Guard authorizes only the signed candidate and both public workflows pass.

release_requirements.required_receipt: Clean exact candidate, dependency manifest, isolated install, full tests, attribution audit, rollback, signed receipts, and public target reconciliation.

stop_conditions: Any required skill-code dependency remains external-only or uninstalled.
Any upstream file lacks attribution or license coverage.
Any install, manifest comparison, hook merge, bridge invocation, test, verifier, or public workflow fails.
Any forbidden path, secret, cache, history, or unexplained diff enters Git.
Independent DEPLOY_READY verdict is not PASS.
known_discrepancies: The public baseline fetched Slopware packages and omitted SpecSwarm and EKG governance skills.
The release workflow was pinned to the previous production contract and must point to this amendment for exact-candidate verification.
